facts.text: The hotel sits on West 57th Street between 6th and 7th Avenues in Midtown Manhattan.
facts.excerpt: sits on West 57th Street between 6th and 7th Avenues.

facts.text: The hotel is two blocks south of Central Park.
facts.excerpt: Just two blocks south of Central Park, Le Méridien places Manhattan’s most iconic green space at your doorstep.

facts.text: Carnegie Hall, Rockefeller Center, MoMA and Columbus Circle are all within reach of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: From this enviable vantage point, guests may discover Carnegie Hall, Rockefeller Center, MoMA and Columbus Circle.

facts.text: Central Park, Carnegie Hall, Fifth Avenue, Rockefeller Center and Broadway are all within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: With Central Park, Carnegie Hall, Fifth Avenue, Rockefeller Center, and Broadway all within walking distance

facts.text: Le Jardin Rooftop Bar has views of Central Park and the city skyline, with drinks and light bites.
facts.excerpt: Ascend to Le Jardin Rooftop Bar for views of Central Park and the city skyline, the perfect spot to unwind with a drink and light bites.

facts.text: Paris Bar is a French brasserie at ground level serving traditional French cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Paris Bar, our iconic French brasserie at the ground level, offering traditional French cuisine

facts.text: Each Terrace King room has a private balcony overlooking 57th Street.
facts.excerpt: Each Terrace King room features a private balcony overlooking 57th Street — perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails with the city as your backdrop.

facts.text: The Park Suites offer views of Central Park.
facts.excerpt: From the refined comfort of our Junior Suites to the expansive Park Suites offering views of Central Park

facts.text: The Penthouse Suite has two bedrooms, a spacious common area and sweeping views of Central Park.
facts.excerpt: At the pinnacle, the one-of-a-kind Penthouse Suite features two bedrooms, two and a half bathrooms, and a spacious common area — all offering sweeping views of Central Park

facts.text: The Penthouse Suite has two and a half bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: our spacious Penthouse Suite features two bedrooms, a plush living room, your very own dining area, and two and a half baths.

facts.text: The Penthouse Suite has three bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: our premium 2-bedroom, 3-bath Penthouse Suite

facts.text: Bathrooms are marble, with Malin and Goetz bath amenities.
facts.excerpt: Refresh in our sparkling marble bathrooms, equipped with upscale Malin and Goetz bath amenities

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, and many offer Midtown Manhattan views.
facts.excerpt: Our New York City accommodations have floor-to-ceiling windows; many offer Midtown Manhattan views

facts.text: Rooms have a coffee and tea station with Illy coffee.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy thoughtful in-room comforts including Malin & Goetz bath amenities, a coffee & tea station with Illy coffee

facts.text: The concierge team helps with things from an umbrella on a rainy day to a personalized Manhattan itinerary.
facts.excerpt: Our expert concierge team is here to anticipate your every need, from providing an umbrella on a rainy day to helping craft a personalized Manhattan itinerary.

facts.text: The fitness center has the latest cardio and strength-training equipment.
facts.excerpt: Stay on track with your wellness goals in our 24-hour fitness center, featuring the latest cardio and strength-training equipment.

facts.text: Le Meridien Hub is a modern reinterpretation of the traditional hotel lobby, a place for guests to gather and connect.
facts.excerpt: A modern reinterpretation of the traditional hotel lobby, Le Méridien Hub offers an array of opportunities for guests to gather, connect and simply savor the moment.

facts.text: The hotel holds LEED New Construction certification.
facts.excerpt: LEED: New Construction Certified

facts.text: Pets are welcome, up to 2 per room.
facts.excerpt: Up to 2 pets are allowed per room.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 21

facts.text: Self-parking is off-site at GMC Garage on West 56th Street.
facts.excerpt: Self-parking is available through GMC Garage at 150 West 56th Street (btwn 6th & 7th aves).

facts.text: Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
facts.excerpt: No, the rooms at Le Méridien New York, Central Park do not permit rollaway beds.

facts.text: The hotel is 100% smoke-free.
facts.excerpt: Le Méridien New York, Central Park is an 100% smoke-free hotel.

contradictions.note: p2 says two and a half bathrooms in one place and 3-bath in another
